package day2;

public class Dailyassignment05_10_26 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		//whether a number is a spy number
		//spy number means if the sum of its digits is equal to the product of its digits
		
		int num=1124;
		int sum=0;
		int product=1;
		int original=num;
		System.out.println("Enter a number: "+num);
		for(;num>0;)
		{
			int lastdigit=num%10;
			sum=sum+lastdigit;
			product=product*lastdigit;
			num=num/10;
		}
		System.out.println("Sum of digits = "+sum);
		System.out.println("Product of digits = "+product);
		if(sum==product)
			System.out.println(original+" is a spy number");
		else
			System.out.println(original+" is not a spy number");
		
		//Magic number program
		//keep adding the digits until you get a single digit. if the final digit is 1,the number is a magic number
		
		int num=172;
		int original=num;
		int digitsum=0;
		int finaldigit=0;
		System.out.println("Enter a number: "+num);
		for(;num>0;)
		{
			int lastdigit=num%10;
			digitsum=digitsum+lastdigit;
			num=num/10;
		}
		System.out.println("Digit Sum = "+digitsum);
		for(;digitsum>0;)
		{
			int lastdigit2=digitsum%10;
			finaldigit=finaldigit+lastdigit2;
			digitsum=digitsum/10;
		}
		System.out.println("Final digit = "+finaldigit);
		if(finaldigit==1)
			System.out.println(original+" is a magic number");
		else
			System.out.println(original+" is not a magic number");
	}

}
